source_description: Public YouTube re-upload of Delta Air Lines' September quarter 2026 earnings call (channel 'Castify Earnings Call', title 'Delta Air Lines Inc ($DAL) Q3 2026 Earnings Call', uploaded 2026-10-09, 4069 s, no login). Downloaded with yt-dlp (format 251 Opus) and converted to mp3. The full call is included: operator, prepared remarks and Q&A.
official_webcast_note: Listed in Delta's IR event feed (ir.delta.com) as 'Delta Air Lines 3Q 2026 Earnings Webcast', 10/09/2026 10:00:00. The page is a JavaScript app on the Q4 events platform, which normally asks for registration before playback. It was not opened or used.
alternate_source_note: No other full-call upload was found on YouTube. Other search hits were commentary videos or AI podcasts, not the call.
clip_format: mp3, mono, 24 kHz, 64 kbps CBR, 30 ms fade-in, 60 ms fade-out
clip_first_words: During the quarter, we further expanded self-service options in the Fly Delta app and completed the rollout of Delta Concierge to all SkyMiles members.
clip_last_words: As we move toward our long-term gross leverage target of 1x, we remain committed to increasing returns to shareholders. Now, I'll turn it back to Julie for analyst Q&A.
clip_speakers: Dan Janki (Chief Operating Officer), end of his operations remarks (0:00-0:48)
Erik Snell (Chief Financial Officer), full prepared remarks on results and outlook (0:48-4:26)
recording_starts_at_call_start_explanati: The file opens with the operator's welcome ('Good morning everyone and welcome to the Delta Airlines September quarter 2026 financial results conference call') at 0.0 s. There is no hold music or pre-roll, so offset 0 is the start of the call program. The file carries no wall-clock time, so the exact ET time of that moment is assumed, not measured.

notes: Delta's call was at 10:00 a.m. ET on Friday, October 9, 2026 (Delta's September 18 announcement and the IR event feed). The release was posted at 6:30 a.m. ET.

The clip covers the CFO's whole prepared section, which holds the Q4 and full-year outlook numbers. It does not include the Q4 revenue outlook ('approximately 20 percent year-over-year on roughly 3 percent capacity growth'), which CCO Joe Esposito spoke at 10:57-11:22 in the full audio, more than 6 minutes earlier.
The clip starts in the 1.3 s pause before 'During the quarter' and ends in the 0.7 s pause before Julie Stewart's 'Thank you, Eric'.
Clip ET times assume the operator began at exactly 10:00:00 ET. Conference calls often start 0-2 minutes late, so treat clip ET times as +/- 2 minutes.
